Module dev.metaschema.core

Package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type

package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type
Provides support for Metapath type system and sequence type testing.

This package implements the Metapath type system, which is based on the XPath 3.1 type system. It provides mechanisms for type testing, type matching, and type validation of Metapath items and sequences.

The core interfaces define type information that can be used to:

  • Test if an item or sequence matches a specific type
  • Validate sequences against expected types and cardinality
  • Perform type casting and conversion operations
  • Generate type signatures for error messages and debugging

Key Interfaces

  • IItemType - The base type interface for all item types, providing factory methods for creating tests for atomic types, node kinds, functions, arrays, and maps
  • ISequenceType - Represents a sequence type with cardinality constraints (occurrence indicators)
  • IKindTest - A specialized item type for testing node items by their kind (document, assembly, field, flag)
  • IAtomicOrUnionType - Represents atomic types and union types that can be used for type testing and value conversion
  • IArrayTest - Specialized item type for testing array items with member type constraints
  • IMapTest - Specialized item type for testing map items with key and value type constraints

Supporting Classes

  • Occurrence - Enum representing sequence cardinality indicators (zero, one, zero-or-one, one-or-more, zero-or-more)
  • DataTypeItemType - Item type implementation for Metaschema data types backed by adapters

Exceptions

  • TypeMetapathException - Base exception for type-related errors
  • InvalidTypeMetapathException - Thrown when a value does not match the expected type
